part.text: In the current working directory create calc.ts exporting a function add(a: number, b: number): number, and calc.test.ts with three plain assertion checks of add. Run the test file with node --experimental-strip-types calc.test.ts. Then refactor add into a new function sum, keep add as a thin wrapper, and rerun the test file. Work only inside the current directory.
